notes: the PyG ZINC subset stores Kekule bond orders only (no aromatic flag), so aromaticity can only be re-perceived, never read
tier1 = exact Kekule isomorphism; tier2 = aromatic-relaxed; tier3 = element topology

atom ordering is 'recoverable' only when an attributed isomorphism exists; all descriptors used here are isomorphism-invariant, so an ordering mismatch does not affect them (per-atom RDKit attribution is not used)
